verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS platform, so publishing a downloadable API spec is a fair question to ask, but the evidence contains no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The pricing page's 'Advanced API integrations' line does not show that a public, downloadable machine-readable spec exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
